about.title: Angels Camp Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone suddenly changes everything, and the paperwork that follows can feel impossible. Families in Angels Camp who believe another person's carelessness caused a death have a civil path under California law, separate from anything a prosecutor may or may not do. In 2025, public records show 10 injury collisions and 13 people hurt in the city, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. Crashes tended to cluster on Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., and the heaviest collision counts fell along Rt 49, S Main Street, Rt 4 and Murphys Grade Road. Fatal harm is not limited to the roadway; it also comes from workplace accidents, medical errors, and unsafe property. A wrongful death claim can seek funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects you with an independent attorney who works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Angels Camp Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out standing quickly so the right family members are protected.

items.title: Deadlines Kept in View
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early keeps those dates from slipping by while you grieve.

items.title: A Full Picture of Your Losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. A contingency-fee attorney can pursue all of these without asking you for money upfront.

items.question: Angels Camp recorded zero traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death cases don't happen here?
items.answer: No. The 2025 figures cover roadway collisions only, and wrongful death claims arise from many other situations, including workplace accidents, medical negligence, and unsafe premises. Fatal crashes also do occur in other years along corridors like Rt 49 and Rt 4. If you have lost someone and suspect another party was at fault, it is worth a free conversation.

items.question: How is a wrongful death claim different from the criminal case?
items.answer: A criminal case is brought by the state and seeks to punish the wrongdoer. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family and seeks compensation for losses such as funeral costs and lost support. The two proceed separately, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed.

items.question: What if the crash happened on a state route or involved a public agency?
items.answer: Roads like Rt 49 and Rt 4 may be maintained by a public entity, and claims against government bodies in California carry a much shorter deadline than the usual two years. Missing that early notice period can end a claim before it starts. An attorney can identify who is responsible and act within the correct timeframe.
